evidence.P1: Hunter and the Chosen ev-023->ev-039->ev-045 is and-then with no same-plot enabling, and Reluctant One ev-020 Cypher steak is not caused by ev-016 jump failure within identity plot
evidence.P2: Rescue (self-preservation vs sacrifice), Awakening (truth vs lie), Betrayer (meaning vs pleasure) and Reluctant One (identity) each hold one stance; Hunter stays nominally on freedom vs determinism without retelling whole film

evidence.P4: Reluctant One ev-008 to ev-045, Rescue ev-025 to ev-035, Awakening ev-004 to ev-013 and Betrayer ev-020 to ev-029 close setup-turn-resolution; Hunter ev-014 to ev-045 truncates with no middle turn
evidence.P5: Hunter and the Chosen duplicates Reluctant One verbatim on ev-014, ev-023, ev-039, ev-045 and Rescue/Betrayer share ev-025 and ev-026 as central beats

raw.commentary: Layer has three causally tight plots (Rescue, Awakening, Betrayer) but Reluctant One stretches causality via ev-020 and Hunter is a 4-beat and-then; perspective discipline is otherwise strong, membership is padded and Hunter is gapped, four arcs close but Hunter dangles, and Hunter is a direct rehash of Reluctant One with Rescue/Betrayer overlap driving redundancy down.
